---

## Featured Project: CT Viewer
* **What:** Browser-based 3D visualization of industrial computed tomography (CT) scans, powered by a scalable backend architecture.
* **Context:** Engineering thesis, built by a team of four with the National Centre for Nuclear Research (NCBJ); supervisors: dr Tomasz Piłka (UAM), dr Konrad Klimaszewski (NCBJ).
* **Stack:** Python (workers: h5py, NumPy, trimesh), MinIO (S3-compatible object storage), FastAPI (presigned URLs), Docker, Flutter Web client with Three.js and WebGL (mesh and volume rendering).
* **Engineering highlights:** HDF5 ingest pipeline with downsampling, Multi-Otsu segmentation, Marching Cubes and mesh decimation (GLB / STL export); background workers; object storage with presigned URLs so the browser reads data directly; interactive client with three-plane 2D slices, 3D meshes (clipping, capping) and WebGL volume rendering for non-destructive testing (NDT).
* **Recognition:** Information Systems Engineering Award (Young Masters Competition) at Forum Teleinformatyki 2026, Asseco Poland patronage; invitation to the Ministry of Digital Affairs.
